_comment: Saplings (ADR 0112). A sapling set on soil (GameMaterials.is_soil) grows into its tree after grow_s game seconds (a random time in [min, max], scaled like the farm by farm_speed) once its spot is inside the simulated area and the trunk's column is clear. trees: per GameMaterials.WOOD_KINDS kind, the materials it is built of and its size in metres: trunk_m = trunk width, height_m = [min, max] trunk height, crown_m = crown radius, crown = 'ball' (a leaf ball round the top) or 'cone' (stacked shrinking balls, spruce). Leaves only fill air.
